title: Dev-Lead Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the dev-lead advisory persona: an issue/PR-readiness input paired with its expected readiness judgment. Each line of evals/dev-lead/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The persona judges whether work is ready to implement and lands a concrete recommendation, so the expected decision is readiness-shaped (readiness / recommend) — NOT the triage {escalate, risk} shape of evals/case.schema.json. This is the trust anchor for the persona's skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case. Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and what grounds the expected readiness judgment.

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the readiness concern a case exercises ('scoping', 'risk', 'readiness', 'negative').

input.description: The pre-fetched review context exactly as the advisory consumes it: a self-contained description of the issue or PR whose readiness is under review.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected readiness judgment the persona must produce for this work item.

readiness.description: Whether the work is ready to implement as-is ('ready') or must be scoped/specified first ('needs-scoping').

recommend.description: The concrete recommendation the advisory must land (what to do before or during implementation).
